crusadecraft.cb.guerre_sainte.desc: Call a crusade against a pagan or heretic realm (100 piety). Faithful realms rally to it, other rulers are called. Victory: the target province is yours, and every crusader receives piety and prestige.
crusadecraft.war.cb.not_infidel: This realm shares your faith: no holy war against it.
crusadecraft.war.cb.need_county: You must be at least a count to call a crusade.
crusadecraft.war.cb.no_piety: Not enough piety: a crusade costs 100.
crusadecraft.crusade.already: You are already part of this war.
crusadecraft.crusade.bound: A treaty binds you to the target: you cannot take the cross against it.
crusadecraft.letter.crusade.subject: A call to crusade
crusadecraft.letter.crusade.body: By this letter, the leader of the crusade — %1$s — calls all the faithful to take the cross against %2$s. Join your arms to theirs: victory will be blessed.
crusadecraft.tournament.title: Tournament Lists
crusadecraft.tournament.host.tip: Your knights (councillors and mayors) face the champions of neighbouring realms. Prestige for the host, glory for the winner, and sometimes a wound.
crusadecraft.tournament.need_research: The "Chivalry" research is needed at the capital's University.
crusadecraft.tournament.no_gold: Not enough gold to hold a tournament.
crusadecraft.tournament.no_knight: No knight: appoint councillors or mayors.
crusadecraft.tournament.bout.wounded: Round %1$s: %2$s against %3$s — %4$s wins, the loser is wounded
crusadecraft.toast.tournament.title: The tournament ends
crusadecraft.house.title: Your house
crusadecraft.house.empty: Your house is empty. Welcome councillors or mayors into it; their spouses and children will follow.
crusadecraft.house.make_heir.tip: An heir reassures the court: prestige +10 the first time, and factions weigh less.
crusadecraft.house.adopt.tip: Bring this citizen into your house: %s prestige. They will be grateful.
crusadecraft.house.no_candidate: No councillor or mayor to welcome.
crusadecraft.house.pick_member: Pick a member free to marry on the left.
crusadecraft.house.not_eligible: This member cannot marry: a child, already married, or with a spouse in their colony.
crusadecraft.house.block.faith: This realm does not share your faith: no marriage.
crusadecraft.house.nobody_to_marry: Nobody in your house is free to marry.
crusadecraft.house.not_member: This citizen is not of your house.
crusadecraft.house.not_subject: This citizen does not live in your realm.
crusadecraft.letter.marriage_accept.body: By this letter, %1$s agrees to unite their family with yours through the marriage of %2$s. Seal it, and both houses will be allied.
crusadecraft.letter.marriage_offer.body: By this letter, %1$s proposes to unite your houses and asks for the hand of %2$s. Seal it to accept; a defensive alliance will follow.
crusadecraft.letter.marriage_refuse.body: By this letter, %1$s declines the honour of a union with %2$s.
crusadecraft.chronicle.house.birth: Birth in the house: %s, child of %s.
